_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::lubrication#5. Confirms the entry's 'exactly 10x' for a poise-vs-Pa.s viscosity slip (ratio 10.000000 to 15 digits) and measures a m/s-vs-mm/s velocity slip (1e-3), on upstream lubrication_sb_2d.4C.yaml. It also FALSIFIES the entry's h exponent: the entry said 'h in mm vs m gives factor 1e9 off', but pressure goes as 1/h^2 (the h^3 sits inside the divergence, one power spent on the second gradient), so a 1000-fold h slip moves the pressure by 1e6, measured here. 4C prints no unit or scaling diagnostic at all. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).

_mutation.note: remove the viscosity unit slip: keep SI Pa.s in the POISE arm. The 10.000000 ratio becomes 1 and the fixture must go red.
remove the velocity unit slip: keep 20000 in the MMPS arm. The 1e-3 ratio becomes 1 and the fixture must go red.
remove the film-height unit slip: keep metres in the HMM arm. The 1e-6 ratio that falsifies the claimed 1e9 disappears and the fixture must go red.
